lead/booking/reservation counts and timestamps are SYNTHETIC (crm_signals_origin = synthetic_v1_causal_funnel); used for descriptive validation only.
agency_name is tagged synthetic via agency_name_origin.
data_profile = 'demo' for all 392 units — this is not production CRM data.
AHP weights encode the spec's 35/30/20/15 starting template as pairwise ratios; they are assumptions and must be replaced by elicited expert judgments.
Source price_per_sqm_* columns are computed from loan_price_vnd, not standard_price_vnd; recalculated per spec Step 5 and the source values retained as *_source for audit.
Score bands (90/80/70/60) are for discussion and require domain-expert review.
